material_points.finding: Generic Receipt Insight sample screenshots display Purchase Order as Receipt id type. This is not TAB PO-use evidence and not Purchase Order Insight runtime inspection. Owner current PO non-use remains controlling.
Returns montage is legacy RF, consistent with initial-go-live full-screen/legacy fallback and inconsistent with treating the figure as evidence of Warehouse Mobile blind-receiving acceptance.

Mobile receiving montage shows license-plate input although TAB prose describes system-generated assignment. The montage is an illustrative configuration, not sufficient to establish exact TAB preference behavior.
Receiving diagram depicts printed worksheet without showing its optional/usual-non-use qualification; retain prose qualification. Putaway flow also omits TAB-specific Conveyor/TRAV_PALLET/P&D stages.

Generic screenshots contain capabilities and sample values not applicable to TAB by default: lot/expiry, Work Order, Pallet Building, Crossdock, Hazmat, FedEx, sample cycle thresholds. These must not override stated non-use or unresolved configuration.
Wave Cancel and Release screenshots box grey commands on Released sample rows. Command highlighting identifies a UI location, not enablement or successful transaction.
Security figures show configuration surfaces and an unfilled Create new form, not TAB access grants.

Several figures demonstrably come from other sample warehouses/environments and earlier dates. All figures remain documentary illustrations, even though their containing SDD is an official TAB core source.
